items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: Pinn's. Pinn's. Just like Samuel Pinn's.

ctx.x: Well, that's Trapania sitting in the, in back of the snare drum, first snare drum on the left. That's right, that's right. Kind of a stout fellow.
Yeah, good picture of him. Mm-hmm. Now you ever heard talk of Oinness Pinn, banjo player? I think so. Well, that's, that, that's what's one fellow. Ernest? Pinn's. Pinn's. Just like Samuel Pinn's.
